name: Serengeti
tagline: Endless plains and the Great Migration
summary: The Serengeti's endless grasslands host the Great Migration, with over a million wildebeest moving in a year-round loop. Lions, cheetahs and leopards follow, making it one of the best places on earth for big cats.
seasonNote: Calving in the south January to March; river crossings in the north July to October. April and May are long rains.
arrival: Fly to Seronera airstrip from Arusha, or drive 7-8 hours via Ngorongoro.
cashTip: Safaris and park fees are usually paid in US dollars by card; carry shillings for tips and local shops. Prices here are in shillings.
foodTip: Lodge meals; try nyama choma and chapati.
buyTip: Maasai beadwork from villages near Ngorongoro.
baseArea: Central Seronera, or follow the migration

connections.note: Light aircraft, or a long drive via Ngorongoro.
